summary: Network & cloud security engineer with ~5 years securing enterprise and hybrid-cloud environments for global organizations including Daimler/Mercedes-Benz, now building cybersecurity products at AuthenticOne. Deep multi-vendor firewall expertise — Palo Alto NGFW, Panorama, FortiGate, Check Point, Cisco Secure Firewall (FTD/FMC) — across VPN, NAT, high availability, and routing (BGP/OSPF) on Azure and AWS, with a proven record of owning high-severity incidents end-to-end under 24x7 SLAs. I pair deep operator experience with a builder's mindset to design secure, resilient systems and the tooling security teams actually need.

experience.title: Senior Cybersecurity Consultant
highlights: Build and enhance cybersecurity products end-to-end — including developing and extending an endpoint detection & response (EDR) tool — from threat model to shipped feature
Own EDR agent release and rollout automation: CI/CD pipelines, code-signing across Windows/macOS/Linux, signed manifests on stable and edge channels, and legacy-agent migration with rollback
Translate frontline firewall, VPN, and cloud-security experience into product features that solve real security-operator workflows
Apply threat modeling and secure-development practices across the SDLC, and support the SOC team with monitoring, triage, and hardening reviews

experience.title: Associate Consultant
highlights: Delivered end-to-end cybersecurity consulting including problem analysis, effort estimation, firewall architecture design, and deployment across 30+ enterprise sites

Provided L2/L3 support for multi-vendor firewalls (Palo Alto, FortiGate, Check Point, Cisco Firepower), managing security policies, NAT, VPNs, upgrades, and high-availability configurations at 1k–5k rule scale
Managed Check Point end to end via SmartConsole — migrations, version upgrades and hotfixes, rule-base cleanup, and HA clusters
Led POCs for firewall and cloud security solutions and implemented security hardening for 24x7 SLA-driven production systems

experience.title: Network Security Engineer
highlights: Owned escalated Palo Alto NGFW cases for Palo Alto Networks' Top 25 and Platinum enterprise customers — typically 10–15 active cases across estates of 200+ firewalls — resolving high-severity incidents within strict SLA targets

Designed, deployed, and supported secure hybrid cloud architectures across Azure, AWS, GCP, and VMware vSphere, including advanced troubleshooting of GlobalProtect, IPsec/SSL VPNs, GRE, MACSec, and routing (BGP, OSPF)

Built and operated replication lab environments to isolate OS-level defects, performed deep packet inspection using Wireshark, and delivered 1000+ enterprise security solutions across large datacenter environments

Designed and supported high-availability firewall and F5 load-balancing (LTM/GTM) architectures, automated PAN-OS configuration with Terraform and Ansible, and mentored 30+ junior engineers while authoring SOPs and KB articles
